_note: Roadmap engine (app/pai_c/roadmap/engine.py) policy. status_order sorts the field cards and the summary chips. The engine returns reasons as {key, values}; copy holds the English template per key ({name} placeholders are the reason's values; choose_group groups render as their route_label (e.g. FSc Pre-Engineering) joined by group_joiner). education_line renders the header from the Vault. official_confidence: a rule with any other confidence shows the check_with_university note. compare: how many cards the Compare table takes. step_* keys render the chosen route checklist (app/pai_c/roadmap/decisions.py): each need, each entry test, then applying for the degree.
